title: Nexus RunSummary
description: Summary row for a compute run in a paginated list (GET /v1/daemon/compute/runs). Lightweight — excludes full proposals and invocation params.

status.description: Run lifecycle status. Product mapping: succeeded = "Needs review", applied = "Applied", discarded = "Discarded", failed = "Failed".

module_version.description: Version of the module at invocation time.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of run creation.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of last status change (succeeded/failed/applied/discarded).

accepted_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when accepted. Present only when status is "applied".
